launch_film.desc: launch / hype film: tiers 1-3, one hero hit per 8-10 s, end on logo + 0.15 s silence

mime_spot.desc: wordless character comedy: one gag + one product feature, one sound per action beat, comic pause of 4-8 frames before the punchline

beat_edit.desc: music / beat-synced edits: cuts on beats, sfx on the off-beats, biggest visual on the drop

talking_head.desc: human / talking-head retention edit: voice first, sfx are punctuation 12-24 dB under the voice, no tier 1 except the end logo

short_film.desc: animated / live short film: sound leads the cut (J/L), room tone under every shot, rare hero hit, LRA 10-15 LU, no whoosh transitions
short_film.master_note: festival / broadcast master = -23 LUFS-I / -1 dBTP kept separate from the -14 social cut

product_ad.desc: product ad: tactile micro-sounds locked to close-ups, logo 0.2 s after the last visual

kinetic_type.desc: kinetic typography: one sound per word appear, +3 dB on emphasised words, no sound on pure fades

loop_short.desc: seamless social loop: audible event on frames 0-3, tail wraps into the first 300 ms, state-change loop
loop_short.notes: use the loop8 beds (seamless); render the cue tail with circular placement or crossfade the master

india_festive.desc: India-market ad / festive spot: tabla or dhol groove, one shehnai or sitar phrase, conch or temple bell only on the hero moment
india_festive.notes: music beds: music/bed_indian_fusion_loop8, bed_festive_dhol_loop8, bed_bhangra_dhol_loop, bed_tabla_keherwa_loop; sonic logo music/logo_sitar_orbit

voice_agent_demo.desc: voice-assistant product demo / screen recording: mic on, listening loop under the waveform, think pulse, reply bloom; device sounds on every UI action

office_comedy.desc: office short film / comedy series: foley on every contact, word-free crowd reactions, comic stings on the turn; room tone under every shot
office_comedy.notes: foley ids have 4 round-robin takes (repeat an id and the mixer changes the take); keep crowd reactions 6-10 dB under the bed's loudest moment

saas_launch.desc: sentence-led SaaS / AI product film: a UI tick on every state change, card whooshes, the agent-at-work texture under step lists, a soft slam on the brand colour field, logo last
saas_launch.notes: in a music-led cut, target >= 60% of cuts within 2 frames of an onset (cuts/cutgen.py snap; a VO-led or continuous film is scored by its mode, references/critic.md); end the 'working' loop at the result frame (mixer add_cue until_frame); one slam only, on the cut to the brand field

mockumentary.desc: documentary-parody comedy: room tone under every interview, hard dialogue cuts, a record scratch or tape stop on the format break, deadpan stingers, silence before the punchline
mockumentary.notes: dialogue drives the cut (cuts/patterns.json mockumentaryReaction: 0.3-0.5 s reaction inserts); the stinger lands after the line, never over it

archive_open.desc: archive / heritage opening into a late drop: projector clatter under archive footage, a typewriter line on all-caps credit cards, near-silence on the turn, the beat drops on the product name
archive_open.notes: cuts/patterns.json lateDrop: projector + typewriter only until the drop (no beat, no bass); the bed enters on the turn line; end with preStingSilence (1-3 s, room tone at most) before to_black

neon_power_on.desc: electric / neon look: an arc zap on the frame the outline strikes, the crackle loop under the lit sign (stop it with until_frame), flicker on a glitch, zap-off on the frame the light dies
neon_power_on.notes: one arc per outline strike (the id is rr:4: a repeated cue gets a different strike); the buzz is tuned to A2 (110 Hz), so it sits under A-major beds; levels over the bed: arc +3.5 dB (manifest over_bed_db), zap-off about +2, the crackle loop about 10 dB under the bed, ended on the zap-off frame

trailer.desc: film trailer: braams on the act-3 bar downbeats, booms and metal hits on cards, risers that end one frame before the hit, a reverse suck into the silence before the title, a button sting, a final hit on the release card
trailer.notes: the score carries the act-3 braams (every bar) and the title hit: do not double them; risers end ONE FRAME BEFORE the hit (cue frame = hit - 1, the anchor is the end); the silence before the hit is 1-3 s (cuts/trailer/silenceBeforeHit) and is marked in plan.audio.quiet as a gap; loops (clock, heart, drones, strings, radio) sit 10 dB under the bed unless the plan sets overBedDb

saas_ui.desc: SaaS launch film / product demo / changelog: one quiet sound per UI action under a bright bed: hover tick, click, drag lift and drop snap, zoom to region, highlight ring, palette open, typed keys and the chord of a shortcut, the soft ticks of a streaming answer, a toast per notification, a chime on the result, the price reveal, the integration link; logo last
saas_ui.notes: a UI film is busy: let gfxCues give one cue per action and keep them under the bed (the mixer's ui tier, overBedDb -9 to -12 on headlines and stream ticks); never two clicks inside 3 frames; one chime per result, one slam on the cut to the end card; set plan ceilingDb -2.5 (click transients push the AAC probe); synthesised, measured, never auditioned by a person: listen once before a hero use

hardware_launch.desc: AI-hardware / device launch film: a dark cold open on a sub heartbeat and an electric hum, an airy shimmer on the light sweep, ONE deep sub hit on the reveal, a metal chime on the name, a magnetic release and seat for the exploded view, a detent click per spec or port, a connector click-in on the IO tour, a fan spin-up and a power-on tone when it boots, logo last
hardware_launch.notes: the fitted dark-to-reveal score is music/reveal.py (the drop lands on the reveal frame; templates/hardware-reveal builds it per cut); one reveal hit per film, the sub pulse only in the dark open (round-robin seeds), the hum about 10 dB under the bed and stopped with until_frame on the reveal; a detent per spec row, never a chime per row (one chime on the name, one on the hero spec); the price / date card gets a soft hit, not a stinger
